title: Three against four — Move a single Four note between Three’s three entrances
help: Three keeps its notes at slots one, five and nine. Four keeps only its first note: offsets zero, four and eight place it at those three entrances in turn. Each measure has four notes but only three occupied slots; a meeting does not remove either voice.
rows: Four meets Three at the opening
Four meets Three in the middle
Four meets Three near the end
message: rests comparisons preserve the authored experiment without replacing its memory
